criteria.evidence: Directly reopened r2 mesh shell matches the 12-vertex converted ring of Purdue GIS BuildingShapesZip4 FID 803 (SOHIL, Hillel Foundation, 912 W State St) to <0.001 m. County 2019 minutes identify the same Hillel site, and the reported existing area (~6,500 sq ft) is close to the transformed GIS area (~610.95 m² / 6,574 sq ft).
criteria.uncertainty: GIS layer survey/date metadata is not stated. County hearing also discusses a proposed 845 sq ft addition, with completion unresolved; the model preserves the candidate pre-addition footprint.

criteria.evidence: Shell is directly positioned in the documented local campus coordinate frame and follows GIS footprint vertices. GIS bounds are approximately 31.40 × 25.58 m; transformed area agrees reasonably with county's approximate area. County hearing text says the front faces Waldron Street; model places its principal entry on the west frontage.
criteria.uncertainty: Coordinates use the project's approximate conversion, not survey control. Exact structural dimensions/frontage registration were not established independently of the GIS polygon.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: GIS attributes report one level; the official Spring 2022 Hillel newsletter exterior photograph shows a low single-storey building and a broad, shallow/low-slope roof edge. The r2 model represents one low volume with broad flat eaves.
criteria.uncertainty: No measured elevation or roof pitch is available. The 3.6576 m shell height and ~0.7 m eave depth are explicitly visual estimates/placeholders, not source measurements.

criteria.evidence: Compared r2 oblique/front renders against the official Spring 2022 newsletter photograph. Both show light buff masonry, repeated tall multi-light window bays, substantial pale framing/piers, a prominent entrance/sign panel, and a broad shallow roof edge. The county minutes independently say the front faces Waldron Street; the model puts its entry at that side.
criteria.uncertainty: Newsletter image is oblique and not compass-registered; exact window count, positions, sizes, entry dimensions and masonry/roof materials remain schematic. Model is a simplified representation, not a verified elevation.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Saved r2 .blend reopened directly in Blender 4.5.15. Expected scene and named asset collection exist with four mesh objects; no linked libraries or unpacked external images. Three r2 preview renders, raw GIS snapshot, source provenance, county documents, Hillel official source snapshot, and reopen validation are present.
criteria.uncertainty: Asset portability and collection structure pass. The model's render engine is Blender 4.5 EEVEE Next; successful render-generation is evidenced by saved previews, but another Blender version's engine compatibility is not established.
